from.place: Proof, Step 1 (full faithfulness via faithfully flat descent of a morphism compatible with the descent data): pull the fpqc covering back along the source scheme before applying representable descent

title: An fpqc covering remains an fpqc covering after base change
statement: Let $S$ and $U$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $g:U\to S$ be a morphism, and let $(f_i:X_i\to S)_{i\in I}$ be an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Form the fibre products $U\times_S X_i$ [def-pc-fibre-product] and let $q_i:U\times_S X_i\to U$ be their first projections. Then $(q_i)_{i\in I}$ is an fpqc covering of $U$.
